request.description: weathered medieval adventurer, iron chainmail hauberk over dark leather jerkin, deep crimson hooded cloak, steel longsword held low in right hand, small round wooden shield on left arm, brown leather boots, grown-up adult proportions, gritty muted earthy colours, standing idle facing the viewer

idle.action_description: standing still on guard, breathing slowly, sword and shield held ready

walk.action_description: walking forward at a steady pace, sword held low in the right hand and shield on the left arm, cloak swaying

attack.action_description: swinging the longsword in a fast diagonal slash in front of him, then returning to guard

down.action_description: knocked out, collapsing backwards and lying flat on the floor, still

notes: v3 character at size 40 (body 36 px). The template idle/walk/death clips were rejected: they redrew the hero and dropped or added the shield between frames. Walk drops the reference frame 0 (it repeats the idle pose). Down ends lying flat; the renderer holds the last frame while recovering.
